sentences.sentence: A block highlighted in the browser fetches the tree-sitter runtime (about 115 kB gzipped) and each grammar it shows, once; an HTML block also loads JavaScript and CSS, a Svelte block TypeScript and CSS.

sentences.sentence: Every client build carries all twenty grammar files and the runtime, about 23.5 MB raw (2.15 MB gzipped).
A strict Content Security Policy needs 'wasm-unsafe-eval': the runtime compiles WebAssembly.
Every one takes its colour from the highlighter: tree-sitter for twenty-one, Shiki for five.
No token is bold or italic.
Destructive and success sit on their tints; caution is a card with a yellow bar.
A state is a border and text in its colour, with no tint, so it reads on a hover row; caution is solid yellow with ink text.
A light figure that uses chart-3 (yellow) labels that series directly.
Three colour fields, one owned moment each: the hero's object on blue, the proof on yellow, the console on green.
Yellow is the one known exception: a yellow series is labelled directly.
